_readme: The interview, one question per screen. stage 'basics' = asked before chats (only q1 and q5 are required); stage 'deep' = 'Get to know them', asked after chats. Types: short | long | choice (options, tap one; 'other' adds a free-text box) | reply (shows 'prompt' as your message; the answer is how they'd reply, and becomes a training example). Keep existing ids: backend code reads q1-q21 (see style.py, personality.py, smalltalk.py). Answers to every id are also given to the optional AI modes as facts.

questions.text: First, what's their name?
What do you call them?
questions.hint: A nickname, or just their name.

questions.text: And what do they call you?
questions.hint: Every endearment counts. Separate with commas.

questions.text: Who are they to you?
In chat, they usually come across as…

Their typing style?

options: Lots of short messages in a row

questions.text: Emojis?

options: Leaves me on seen for hours

questions.text: When deciding something, they're more…
options: A bit of both (logical and emotional)
